    Excel¶

    rn_forge.commons.data.excel ¶

    Excel workbook, formatting, and tabular export helpers built on openpyxl.

    Requires the excel extra. :class:ExcelAdapter additionally needs the pandas extra.

    CellFormat(font=None, fill=None, border=None, number_format=None, alignment=None, protection=None) dataclass ¶

    Bases: DataclassMixin

    Cell formatting attributes applied via :meth:ExcelUtils.format_row.

    All fields are optional; only non-None values are applied to cells.

    from_dict(data) classmethod ¶

    Create an instance from a dict, recursively rebuilding nested dataclasses.

    Only keys that match declared dataclass field names are passed to the constructor. This makes from_dict tolerant of extra data (e.g. when loading from a config file that has fields added in a newer schema version). Nested dataclass-typed fields are reconstructed recursively for common container annotations, via :mod:dacite.

    Note a nested dataclass field's own overridden from_dict (if any) is not called — dacite structures nested dataclasses itself.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    data dict[str, Any]

    A dict whose keys correspond to dataclass field names. Unrecognised keys are silently ignored, or rejected when the class's __dacite_config__ sets strict.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Self

    A new instance of this class populated with matching field values.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    A value does not match its field's declared type, a required field is absent, or an enum-typed field names a member the enum does not define. Under strict, also a key that names no field, at any nesting level; the message lists every such key by its dotted path (repository.archtype).
    TypeError

    If the subclass was not decorated with @dataclasses.dataclass.

    ExcelAdapter ¶

    Adapters between workbook primitives and pandas DataFrames.

    Requires the pandas extra. Use this layer when the calling code wants pandas for transformation but openpyxl for workbook-level formatting or templating.

    Example::

    data = ExcelAdapter.read_dataframe("orders.xlsx")
workbook = ExcelAdapter.from_dataframe(data)
ExcelUtils.write_workbook(workbook, "build/orders-copy.xlsx")

    Read a workbook file into a sheet-name keyed DataFrame mapping.

    ExcelUtils ¶

    Excel workbook operations via openpyxl.

    Requires openpyxl — install with rn-forge-commons[excel].

    Typical workflow::

    wb = ExcelUtils.new_workbook()
sheet = wb.active
sheet.title = "Orders"
sheet.append(["id", "total"])
sheet.append([1001, 42.50])
ExcelUtils.write_workbook(wb, "build/orders.xlsx")

    auto_adjust_column_width(sheet) staticmethod ¶

    Set each column's width to fit the longest cell value in that column.

    column_letter(column_number) staticmethod ¶

    Convert a 1-based column number to its Excel letter(s).

    Examples: 1 → "A", 26 → "Z", 27 → "AA".

    format_row(row, row_format=None, column_formats=None) staticmethod ¶

    Apply row_format and per-column column_formats to every cell in row.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    row tuple[Any, ...]

    Tuple of Cell objects as returned by iterating worksheet rows.

    		 required
    row_format CellFormat | None

    Format applied to every cell in the row before column overrides.

    		 None
    column_formats dict[int, CellFormat] | None

    Mapping of 1-based column index → :class:CellFormat. Applied after row_format, so column-specific values take precedence.

    		 None

    load_workbook(source, read_only=False, keep_vba=False, data_only=False, keep_links=True, rich_text=False) staticmethod ¶

    Name Type Description Default
    source str | Path | BytesIO

    File path or :class:~io.BytesIO containing the workbook.

    Open in read-only mode (faster for large files).

    		 False

    Preserve VBA macros.

    data_only bool

    		 False
    keep_links bool

    Preserve external links.

    		 True
    rich_text bool

    Preserve rich-text cell content.

    		 False

    new_workbook(write_only=False, iso_dates=False) staticmethod ¶

    Create and return a new blank :class:~openpyxl.workbook.Workbook.

    resize_table(sheet, table_name) staticmethod ¶

    Resize the named table to span all rows currently in sheet.

    Updates the table's ref to A1:<last-column><last-row>.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    TypeError

    If the last cell in the final row is a merged cell (no column letter).

    write_xlsx(dataset, column_formats=None, sheet_title='Sheet1') ¶

    Serialise dataset to .xlsx bytes, with per-column number formats.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    dataset 'tablib.Dataset'

    Data to write. Its headers form the first row; without headers only data rows are written.

    		 required
    column_formats Mapping[str, str] | None

    Excel number format per header name, for example {"due": "yyyy-mm-dd", "total": "#,##0.00"}. Columns not named keep the default format.

    		 None
    sheet_title str

    Worksheet title.

    		 'Sheet1'

    Returns:

    Type Description
    bytes

    The workbook as bytes.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    KeyError

    A column_formats key is not a dataset header.
